talks.objective: Talk to the brewing cave staff

dialogues.speaker: Taye
dialogues.text: This is the cave where Aphimead is brewed. Quite the sight, isn't it?

talks.objective: Complete the brewing process with Venti
Hit the device to complete the brewing process

dialogues.speaker: Ca'asho
dialogues.text: We would be in your debt.

dialogues.speaker: Ca'asho
dialogues.text: You're here for the brewing ceremony, right? Welcome.

dialogues.speaker: Ca'asho
dialogues.text: Although, there's been a small problem with the preparations... Some monsters found their way into the Brewblossoms used in the brewing process, and now no one dares venture to the lower levels.

dialogues.speaker: Ca'asho
dialogues.text: Would you be so kind as to go down there and help us deal with them?

talks.objective: Head to the lower level of the bar and capture the monsters with help from the star-shaped blossoms
Complete the interaction to start absorbing pollen and finish the brewing process

dialogues.speaker: Ca'asho
dialogues.text: Thank you! All the pollen has been absorbed.

dialogues.speaker: Ca'asho
dialogues.text: The brewing ceremony is complete. Time to begin the show!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: (test)You're finally here, Traveler... However, there's been a minor situation with the preparations here. A minor one, really.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: (test)But I heard that mead brewing is a part of the celebrations anyway. Why don't you join me in trying it out, Traveler?
